paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 84:18, reporting in the name of R' Yehudah son of R' Simon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The first ב״ר is read as Bereshit Rabbah in the citation פ״פד-יח, chapter 84 section 18. The second is the patronymic son of R' Simon. The two contexts are not interchangeable. No named edition is independently checked; earlier machine פ״פדדיח differs in punctuation.

Yehoshua reports Yehudah son of Simon, with the patronymic continuing across the line break. All three personal title components remain R'; the partial machine name forms do not replace the supplied whole names.
